# Starboard

> GitHub stars organizer with semantic search — sub-product of CodeVetter for repo intelligence.

## Product

- [Home](https://starboard.codevetter.com/): Product
- [Discover](https://starboard.codevetter.com/discover): Browse and search the seeded public repository corpus
- [Tools](https://starboard.codevetter.com/tools): Detected tool and framework intelligence
- [Changelog](https://starboard.codevetter.com/changelog): Verified product history
- [About](https://starboard.codevetter.com/about): Product purpose and scope
- [Privacy](https://starboard.codevetter.com/privacy): Privacy and data handling
- [Terms](https://starboard.codevetter.com/terms): Terms of use

## Machine surfaces

- [Agent catalog](https://starboard.codevetter.com/api/ai): JSON inventory of public surfaces
- [Homepage markdown](https://starboard.codevetter.com/index.md): Product brief without JS
- [This index](https://starboard.codevetter.com/llms.txt)
